_doc: Codex entries. Each category's keys match ids in junk.json / plants.json / robots.json / shards.json / junk.json landmarks. Entries unlock when found: junk = first scooped, plants = first planted, robots = first built, shards = read, landmarks = Lumi rolls near one. kg_per_unit converts compartment units of junk to kilograms for the Stats tab.

metal.desc: Cans, tins and bent brackets. Most of it was made to last, and it did. Pressed into bales, it can be rolled and stamped into something useful again.

plastic.desc: Bottles, crates and the occasional chair. It outlived the people who bought it. It weighs almost nothing, and still the ground under it stayed bare.

glass.desc: Jugs and wine bottles, a few still corked. Sorted by colour, glass melts down beautifully. Lumi likes how the light comes through it.

rubber.desc: Tyres, boots and one very patient rubber duck. Rubber holds water, and water holds mosquitoes. Clearing it makes room for frogs.

electronics.desc: Laptops, radios and televisions with nothing left to say. Inside are tiny useful parts. Lumi keeps the good ones for new friends.

paper.hint: Soft, and slowly going back to soil.
paper.desc: Cardboard boxes, bags and old gloves. Paper is the one kind of junk that is already trying to become soil. Lumi helps it along.

grass.name: Meadow Grass
grass.desc: The first thing to come back, always. Its roots knit the loose dust together so other plants have something to hold on to.

grass2.name: Tufted Grass
grass2.desc: A slightly scruffier cousin. It grows in clumps, and small beetles like to live between them.

celandine.name: Celandine
celandine.desc: Glossy yellow petals that open in the sun and close when clouds pass. Bees find it before they find anything else.

gazania.name: Gazania
gazania.desc: A tough little sun-lover with striped petals. It does not mind poor soil. It seems to enjoy proving people wrong.

heliophila.name: Heliophila
heliophila.hint: The first flower you ever saw here.
heliophila.desc: Small blue flowers that turn to follow the light. One grew beside a crushed can before anyone helped it. That is where this all began.

dandelion.name: Dandelion
dandelion.desc: Golden today, a puff of wishes tomorrow. Each seed rides the wind to a new patch of clean ground. It plants itself, if you let it.

fern.name: Fern
fern.desc: Fronds that unroll like slow fireworks. Ferns are very old. They have come back from worse than this.

shrub.name: Shrub
shrub.desc: A low woody bush. Birds will notice it before you do. Shrubs are how a meadow starts thinking about becoming a wood.

nettle.name: Nettle
nettle.desc: Stingy, stubborn and wonderful. Nettles pull nutrients up from deep down, and caterpillars adore them.

mint.name: Wild Mint
mint.desc: Crush a leaf and the whole hex smells fresh. Mint spreads quickly. Nobody minds.

hedge.name: Hedgerow
hedge.desc: A dense green wall, alive with small rustlings. Hedges are highways for hedgehogs, and hotels for wrens.

pine.name: Pine Sapling
pine.desc: Knee-high today. In a hundred years, a forest that smells of resin and rain. Lumi plants it carefully, for whoever comes after.

iceplant.name: Crystalline Iceplant
iceplant.desc: A desert succulent whose leaves are covered in tiny glassy blisters that store water. It glitters at noon and needs almost nothing to drink.

rooibos.name: Wild Rooibos
rooibos.desc: A needle-leafed bush that turns rusty red in the heat. Its roots go down further than you would believe. It holds the sand in place.

ursinia.name: Ursinia
ursinia.desc: A bright orange desert daisy. After the first rain in years, whole slopes of them opened at once, and the Cradle's old cameras saw it from orbit.

periwinkle.name: Periwinkle
periwinkle.hint: A cold-hardy seed for the Frozen Port.
periwinkle.desc: An evergreen groundcover with violet flowers. It keeps its leaves under snow and simply carries on in spring.

frost_moss.name: Frost Moss
frost_moss.hint: A cold-hardy seed for the Frozen Port.
frost_moss.desc: A tight green cushion that grows on cold stone. It is slow, but it survives what nothing else does, and it makes soil where there was none.

reed.name: Marsh Reed
reed.hint: Plant on the drained streets of the Sunken City.
reed.desc: Tall reeds that drink the silt dry and filter the last of the floodwater. Little birds sit on them and complain about the wind.

marsh_mint.name: Marsh Mint
marsh_mint.desc: Mint that does not mind wet feet. The drained streets smell of it on warm evenings.

scoopie.desc: A small, earnest cleaner with one scoop arm and a lot of enthusiasm. It hums when it finds a good pile.

haulbug.desc: A fork cart that never complains. It carries loose bales to the scale and parks itself neatly afterwards.

seedling.desc: A planter bot with a seed hopper on its back. It pats every seed into the soil, twice, just to be sure.

drip.desc: A watering bot with a sloshy tank. It makes a little happy gurgle when a plant drinks.

multibot.desc: A helper that can clean, plant or water. Not the fastest at anything, but always where it is needed.

skimmer.desc: A little raft robot with a net and a rubber duck for luck. It drifts across the lakes fishing out bottles, and leaves neat bales on the shore.

back_soon.desc: A hand-lettered sign from a bakery. Marta promised to be back soon.

kid_drawing.desc: A crayon drawing, folded small enough to fit a pocket.

gardener_list.desc: Someone's to-do list for a garden. Half the items are ticked.

receipt.desc: A till receipt from the last ordinary day.

maint_log.desc: A maintenance log for a unit that looked a lot like Lumi.

ledger_memo.desc: An office memo about the evacuation. Very polite. Very tired.

voicemail.desc: A voicemail transcript. Someone was calling to say they were safe.

poster.desc: A faded safety poster. The smiling robot on it is waving.

covered_car.name: Covered Car
covered_car.desc: Somebody covered it carefully before they left, as if they meant to come back for it. The tarp has held for a very long time.

concrete_road_barrier.name: Road Barrier
concrete_road_barrier.desc: Once it told traffic where to go. Now moss is slowly telling it where to stay.

exterior_aircon_unit.name: Air Conditioner
exterior_aircon_unit.desc: An old outdoor unit with a rusted fan. Small birds have started nesting behind the grille.

electric_stove.name: Abandoned Stove
electric_stove.desc: Someone carried it this far and then set it down. Its oven door still opens with a cheerful squeak.

Barrel_01.name: Old Barrel
Barrel_01.desc: Empty now, thankfully. Turned on its side it makes a decent shelter for a fox.

metal_trash_can.name: Trash Can
metal_trash_can.hint: The irony is not lost on Lumi.
metal_trash_can.desc: The one place junk was supposed to go. Lumi salutes it every time he passes.

propane_tank.name: Propane Tank
propane_tank.desc: Long since empty and safe. Someone painted a flower on the side, a long time ago.

plastic_monobloc_chair_01.name: Plastic Chair
plastic_monobloc_chair_01.desc: The most common chair in the world. It faces the horizon, as if someone liked to watch the sunset from here.

dead_tree_trunk.name: Old Tree Trunk
dead_tree_trunk.desc: A tree that did not make it. But there are tiny green shoots at its base, and beetles inside, and it is not as dead as it looks.

old_drill_press.name: Drill Press
old_drill_press.desc: A workshop drill press standing alone in a field. The workshop around it is long gone; the press stayed exactly where it was told.

old_military_compressor.name: Field Compressor
old_military_compressor.hint: Out where the wild bases are.
old_military_compressor.desc: A wheeled air compressor, its gauges frozen at 'enough'. It pumped up the tyres of a whole fleet of cleanup carts once.

tree_stump_01.name: Tree Stump
tree_stump_01.hint: Where a forest used to be.
tree_stump_01.desc: Cut, not fallen. The rings count back further than the Ledger. Moss has started a quiet negotiation with the bark.

ocean_buoy.name: Washed-up Buoy
ocean_buoy.desc: A channel buoy that drifted inland on a storm tide and never found its way back. Its lamp still blinks, once an hour, out of habit.

wooden_crate_02.name: Cargo Crate
wooden_crate_02.hint: Near the shore, or the dunes.
wooden_crate_02.desc: A slatted crate stencilled CRADLE SUPPLY: FRAGILE. Packed for the ark's launch three hundred years ago, and left behind in the rush. Empty. Whatever was inside was planted somewhere, a long time ago.

barrel_03.name: Sand-Blasted Drum
barrel_03.desc: Centuries of wind have polished this drum down to bare, shining metal. In the dunes even the junk gets buffed.

dead_quiver_trunk.name: Dead Quiver Tree
dead_quiver_trunk.desc: A desert tree that stored water in its trunk until there was none left to store. It still stands, bleached silver, pointing at the sky.

namaqualand_rocks_01.name: Desert Rocks
namaqualand_rocks_01.desc: Wind-polished stones. Lumi swears one of them looks like WREN's logo. WREN says it does not.

small_lpg_tank.name: Gas Bottle
small_lpg_tank.desc: A small gas bottle with a frozen valve. The harbour heaters once ran on these. Now they run on Lumi.

portable_generator.name: Field Generator
portable_generator.hint: Near the Cradle's old launch field.
portable_generator.desc: A ground-crew generator, still labelled LAUNCH SUPPORT. It powered the floodlights on the night the Cradle left.

utility_box_01.name: Launch Utility Box
utility_box_01.hint: Near the Cradle's old launch field.
utility_box_01.desc: A junction box for the launch field's lights. Someone wrote GOOD LUCK on the door in marker pen, three hundred years ago.

concrete_road_barrier_02.name: Blast Barrier
concrete_road_barrier_02.desc: Barriers that kept the crowd back from the pad. The crowd has been gone a long time. The barriers took their job very seriously.

dust_flats.name: Dust Flats
dust_flats.hint: Research Dune Charts and fly there.
dust_flats.desc: Old salt flats where a solar farm once powered half a continent. Sandstorms roll in every few minutes and bury cleaned ground again; Sustained hexes shelter their neighbours. The well is dry: Drips need Water Tanks.

frozen_port.name: Frozen Port
frozen_port.hint: Research the Thermal Lance and fly there.
frozen_port.desc: A container harbour frozen solid. Junk is locked in ice until it is thawed: Lumi's beam melts it slowly, heaters melt it fast and warm the hexes around them. Plants need a greenhouse, or Cold-Hardy Seeds.

sunken_city.name: Sunken City
sunken_city.hint: Research Pump Works and fly there.
sunken_city.desc: A downtown that went under when the sea walls failed. Skimmers net the floating junk; once most of a ring is clean, the old pumps run and the water drops, revealing streets full of stranded debris.

cradle_returns.name: Cradle Returns
cradle_returns.hint: Restore all three frontiers and research the Ark Beacon.
cradle_returns.desc: The launch city the Cradle left from. Its towers were kept by ground crews, but the landing field is buried. Clean and green the pad, and the ark can come home.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorms
sandstorm.hint: Wait for the wind in the Dust Flats.
sandstorm.desc: The wind picks up junk from the open flats and drops it on clean ground. Planted hexes are never touched, and Sustained hexes break the wind for every hex next to them.

thaw.name: Thawing
thaw.hint: Melt the ice in the Frozen Port.
thaw.desc: Hold the beam on ice and it slowly melts. A heater thaws a whole hex in about a minute and keeps warming the hexes around it.

greenhouse.name: Greenhouses
greenhouse.hint: Build one in the Frozen Port.
greenhouse.desc: A glass hex over clean ground. Anything grows inside, a quarter faster than outdoors.

pumps.name: The Old Pumps
pumps.hint: Clean the water in the Sunken City.
pumps.desc: The city's flood pumps still work. They only needed the drains cleared. Every time they run, a ring of streets comes back out of the water.

ark_pad.name: The Landing Pad
ark_pad.desc: A ring of hexes in front of the base where the Cradle will set down. It has to be clean and Sustained before the ark will trust it.
